integrity.claim_scope: Exact nilpotency and supernilpotency parameters for the stated family only.
integrity.computational_role: Corroborative finite verification, not an infinite proof.
integrity.source_status: The motivating source is a v1 preprint; later revisions could independently state the refinement.

scientific_limitations: The exact formula is specific to the groupoids \(H_n\) of Example 5.4 and is not claimed to be extremal over all groupoids of the same size.
The finite verification covers \(3\le n\le10\); the arbitrary-\(n\) statement rests on the capacity induction in RESULT.md.
title: Exact exponential supernilpotency class of the binary-tree groupoids
